title: docs(pm-dispatch): a claim keeps its in-seat full read, os-dev states the closing-card definition in place, and patrol prose names the 4–6 h standby fallback

_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D3SyXwjiB539uVko32DZJdE)_

Fixes #32873

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:省 token 规则落地后留下的六处过时或易误读的文字改齐:认领仍须席位自己整读(不外包);开发定义不再把卡线程指向 `SKILL.md`;「卡线程为什么要手读 `os-dev.md`」这条实测事实记回事实表;巡查报告行与三条规则行不再写「每小时巡查」和「席位自己达档复审」。
- **为什么改**:这些文字和您 11-12 定的执行要求(待命席 4–6 小时兜底巡查、席位恒默认档、卡线程不读 `SKILL.md`)对不上,读的人会照旧文字做错。
- **风险与回滚**:只改规则文字和一个报告脚本里的说明句,不改任何判定逻辑;每个规则文件行数不变。回滚即 revert。
- **先看**:`scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs` 里 H71 的时钟说明(阈值仍是 2 小时,只改了理由);`platform-readings.md` 删一行换一行;`contract-review.md` 第 20–21 行。
- **两分钟验证**:`pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet && pnpm check:pm-skill-id-lint && pnpm check:pm-half-states`,预期三条都 exit 0。
- **需要你做的**:无,席位落地(Tier S)。

## What changes

**Part 1 — `references/reading-discipline.md:35`, clause order, in place, same bytes (117 B).** 「…⛔ 不只读尾;长线程照 runbook 外包;认领与契约复审仍整读卡/PR 线程。」 The carve-out now closes the line, so it no longer reads as "a claim reads the whole thread and outsources it when long".

**Part 2 — `.claude/agents/os-dev.md:56`.** The pointer 「收口卡定义住 pm-dispatch 报告契约」 led into `SKILL.md`, which a card thread is told not to read. The definition is now stated in place, in the words `SKILL.md` uses: 「…报告点名并入该族收口卡(一卡覆盖全族位置,带枚举钉子)。」 (118 B to 116 B).
- `os-dev.md:356` is left as is: it says the order pastes the frame verbatim and the dev keeps no copy, which is a statement of where the single copy lives, not an instruction to open it.
- The header nit: only one reference carries 「见 SKILL.md 的对应各节」 (`dispatch-runbook.md:3`). Left as is: it scopes the file for a seat reader, and the thread's own rule sits in the same file at `:143` (⛔ 不读 `SKILL.md`); a thread reads that file by section, not from its header.

**Part 3 — `references/platform-readings.md`, one fact row (〈读数陷阱〉, after the harness rows).**

```
- 卡线程不以 `.claude/agents` 定义起:类型只进子代理名单,正文不进上下文 ⇒ 手读 `os-dev.md`。
```

- Source of the original reading: PR 25214 (2026-10-22, the card-thread backend), whose body records "the repo's `.claude/agents` types did not load in a project thread (measured), so the thread reads `os-dev.md`". The line entered `dispatch-runbook.md` with that PR; local history is shallow below 2026-11-08, so the source was read from the PR, not from `git log`.
- Re-measured in this card thread (2026-11-13): the `os-dev` type IS listed on the thread's subagent roster, and the body of `os-dev.md` is NOT in the thread's context (it had to be read by hand). The row records that sharper reading; the consequence for a thread is the same as the dropped clause's.
- Payment (the file is at 458/458 and the order allows no ceiling raise): the row replaces 「`cmd | tail; echo $?` 读到的是 `tail` 的状态 ⇒ 退出码在任何管道之前捕获。」. That fact is held by tools, which the file's own header rule ranks first (「工具先行、文本其次」): `check-half-states.mjs`, `board-snapshot.mjs`, `check-expected-skips.mjs` and `close-cards.mjs` each print the redirect-first spelling in their own output, and `os-dev.md` 168–173 teaches it in full. No gate quotes the removed sentence. Judgment call, flagged for the contract review.

**S4 — `scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs`, H70/H71 prose (report-only rows; no predicate, constant or pin changes).**
- H70 finding sentence: "ONE self-bound hourly patrol routine" becomes "ONE self-bound patrol routine in the same act (every 45 minutes or less while cards are in flight, a 4–6 h fallback patrol on standby)".
- H71 finding sentence: "A seat on duty runs an hourly patrol…" becomes "A seat on duty with cards in flight patrols every 45 minutes or less…", and adds: "A seat on STANDBY wakes on mailbox and PR events plus a 4–6 h fallback patrol: on such a lane a card under ~6 h old may only be waiting for that patrol."
- H71 clock, re-judged: `QUEUE_ON_DUTY_UNCLAIMED_HOURS` stays 2. Its reason is rewritten from "one missed fire plus slack" to the in-flight figure (two missed patrols of 45 minutes or less, plus slack), and says why it does not move: no seat post states standby machine-readably, so the script cannot give a standby lane a longer clock; the row now names the standby reading instead. Raising the constant to 6 would hide a stalled in-flight lane for four more hours and move the 1h59m/2h01m self-test pin; that is a behaviour change outside this card's prose scope.
- The section header comment drops "hourly".

**N6 — three rule lines that read against a seat that is never at the contract tier.**
- `SKILL.md:201`: 「…纯代码面如 `scripts/pm/` 由本席自读(清单不减)后落地。」 (was 「由本席按达档自审」). The first push read 「经子代理或卡线程达档复审」; the seat's contract review (finding A, should-fix) found that it contradicted `contract-review.md:20` (a diff that hits no review face gets CI plus the seat's own read, no second agent), so the line now drops the tier word instead of routing it.
- `contract-review.md:20`: 「…谁跑 = 派发席,档经子代理或卡线程取。」 (was 「达档者席内审」). `:21`: 「取档被配额拒(HTTP 429)⇒ …」 (was 「派发席席内达档审;被配额拒…」).
- `seat-post-protocol.md:18`: the refresh list names a cron change: 「…坐席、串行队/cron 改、撞墙、移交才刷存根。」 To stay inside 120 bytes the separator between `Patrol:` and `Mailbox:` earlier on the same line became a space (116 B to 120 B).

## Line budget (measured)

Every touched rule file keeps its line count and its ceiling: `SKILL.md` 319, `reading-discipline.md` 37, `os-dev.md` 405, `platform-readings.md` 458, `contract-review.md` and `seat-post-protocol.md` unchanged (in-place edits). No re-wrap, no ceiling row touched; widest new line 120 B.

## Tests

- `scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs` was edited in prose only; its own suite is `pnpm check:pm-half-states` (the `--self-test`): exit 0, 5253 cases pass, the `H70/H71 seat patrol` battery included. The H70 text pin (line shape, both rule homes, `Report-only`) and the H71 text pin (`Spare concurrency is NOT judged`, `Report-only`, `lower bound`) and the 1h59m/2h01m window pin are untouched and green.
- No ablation: no tested behaviour changed.

## Acceptance notes

- Merged `origin/main` once, just before opening this PR (head `4d57a233`); no conflict.
- The commit carries the model-free trailer pair.
- Open for the contract review: the paying cut in `platform-readings.md` (above), and the H71 clock staying at 2 with a rewritten reason rather than moving to 6.

## Verification

Run on the final head `4d57a233`, after `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` and a build of `@objectstack/formula` and `@objectstack/lint`. Exit codes captured before any pipe.

- `node scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`: exit 0.
- `pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet`: exit 0. `pnpm check:pm-skill-id-lint`: exit 0. `pnpm check:pm-half-states`: exit 0.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 61 families; all 61 ran and exited 0. `--ran`: "61 derived, 61 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN".
